articles.title: Breguet Watchmaker Gains Popularity Among Collectors
articles.summary: A resurgence in interest has led collectors to focus on Breguet's 1970s-era timepieces, particularly those designed by Daniel Roth.
articles.content: A 251-year-old watchmaker has suddenly gained immense popularity among collectors in recent times. Founded by renowned Abraham Louis-Breguet in the late 18th century, Breguet was once the preferred horologer to royalty. Breguet's contributions to horology are significant, with notable innovations including the tourbillon and its self-winding mechanism. Additionally, its iconic numerals have been widely adopted by Swiss watchmakers. Despite these groundbreaking achievements, Breguet's timepieces had not previously sparked the same level of frenzy among collectors as those from brands like Rolex, Patek Philippe, or Cartier. However, signs indicate that Breguet may be entering a new era of success. Recent auction results suggest a resurgence in interest for the brand's exquisite timepieces. A 1970s-era piece sold at Monaco Legends Group's fall watch auction last month fetched €221,000, previously owned by a 50-year veteran Breguet watchmaker. This sale marks one of several high-profile auction performances that have left many wondering about the sudden interest in Breguet. The resurgence of Breguet's popularity has led collectors to focus on a specific period in the brand's history, marked by Daniel Roth's leadership from the mid-1970s to 1987. During this time, Roth made significant contributions to the brand, introducing innovative designs that have become highly sought after. Roth's legacy can be seen in several notable watches, including the Ref. 3050A, which was a signature piece of his reign at Breguet. This watch marked the introduction of the first modern perpetual calendar from the manufacturer and features a distinctive guilloché dial, characteristic of Roth's design era. The Ref. 3050A sold for €85,800 in late October. Another notable watch from this period is the Classique Perpetual Calendar ref. 3057, which was the successor to the 3050 model. This watch features a transparent caseback, allowing collectors to view the highly decorated automatic movement. The Ref. 3057 sold for significantly more than its estimate, a testament to the rarity and desirability of these timepieces. The success of watches like the Classique Perpetual Calendar ref. 3057 can be attributed in part to the addition of exhibition casebacks, which provide a unique glimpse into the intricate mechanics of Breguet's movements. This feature has proven particularly appealing to collectors, who are willing to pay premiums for these rare and highly sought-after timepieces. The pre-owned Breguet market is experiencing a surge in popularity, as evidenced by recent auction results. A platinum Classique Grandes Complications ref. 5447 perpetual-calendar minute repeater sold for nearly $271,000 at Phillips this weekend. This watch's combination of classical looks and modern movement technology has proven to be a winning formula. The oversized case houses a complex mechanical timepiece that is both functional and visually striking. The sale price is a testament to the enduring appeal of Breguet's unique blend of style and innovation. The Classique Tourbillon ref. 3350, introduced in the late 1980s, is another highly sought-after model. As Breguet's first wrist-worn tourbillon, it marked an important milestone for the brand that invented this complication. The watch features a beautifully guilloché dial, blued steel hands, and a Roman-numeral minute track, all of which are hallmarks of Breguet's signature style. The Daniel Roth era of Breguet production is particularly notable, as it was during this time that the brand began to produce the Type XX flyback chronograph for French military aviators. This watch has since become an important pillar in the brand's lineup and a neo-vintage classic among collectors. Breguet's latest offerings are a testament to its rich heritage and innovative spirit. The Classique Souscription watch, released in 2025 to commemorate the brand's 250th birthday, features a unique single-hand design reminiscent of vintage Breguet pocket watches against a stunning Grand Feu enamel dial. The maison has continued to push boundaries with its latest releases, including a platinum version of the Classique Souscription. This is particularly evident in the Expérimentale 1 watch, which marks the beginning of a new collection that embodies the brand's tradition of innovation and complication. The Expérimentale 1 boasts an impressive array of cutting-edge features, including a high-frequency tourbillon that beats at a remarkable 10 Hz. This represents a significant milestone in modern watchmaking, as it brings together advanced materials with traditional craftsmanship to create something truly exceptional. With its unparalleled history spanning over two and a half centuries, Breguet's resurgence in popularity is a welcome development for enthusiasts of fine horology. As the world of luxury watches continues to evolve, it's clear that this iconic brand remains at the forefront of innovation and style. GQ : https://www.gq.com/story/breguet-watch-glossary-11-10-26

articles.title: High-end Laptop Prices Soar with Three-Fold Increase
articles.summary: The ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14's price jumped from $1,050 in 2020 to around $3,600 today.
articles.content: The prices of high-end laptops have skyrocketed in recent years, but one particular model stands out for its dramatic increase in cost. The ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14, a gaming laptop released in 2020, was initially priced at $1,050, making it an attractive option for those seeking a powerful and portable device. However, fast-forward to the present day, and buyers can expect to pay significantly more for this same model. Directly purchasing from ASUS will cost around $3,600, while Best Buy is currently offering it for $3,200. These prices represent a staggering three-fold increase over the original launch price, leaving many wondering what factors contributed to such a significant jump. A closer examination of the numbers reveals that inflation accounts for only about $320 of this increase. The remaining bulk of the price hike can be attributed to ASUS's upgrades to the G14's screen, chassis, and graphics between 2020 and 2025, which added around $750 to the sticker price. Furthermore, a more recent jump in memory prices has pushed the cost up by another $1,400. As consumers are now faced with these exorbitant prices, it's worth looking back at what made the original G14 so appealing in 2020. The base model paired an 8GB Ryzen 7 4800HS processor with a GTX 1650 and a 60Hz 1080p display, while the review configuration boasted a more powerful Ryzen 9 4900HS, an RTX 2060 Max-Q, 16GB of RAM, and a 120Hz screen. The G14's specs and price made it an attractive option for those seeking a lightweight gaming laptop. Weighing in at roughly 3.5 pounds and measuring just 0.7 inches thick, the Zephyrus line had already established itself as a force to be reckoned with in the gaming laptop market by 2020. The G14's price increase is particularly notable given its history within the Zephyrus lineup. The first 15-inch model in this series was released in 2017 and priced at $2,699. This new iteration brought the price down significantly, making it an attractive option for those seeking a high-performance gaming laptop without breaking the bank. The ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 has undergone significant changes in its pricing over the years. In 2022, the laptop was revamped to feature AMD Radeon graphics, which led to a substantial price increase to around $1,650 for the RX 6700S model. A year later, NVIDIA GPUs returned to the fold, and an RTX 4060 configuration retailed at approximately $1,600. Meanwhile, the top-of-the-line model with an RTX 4090 and a mini-LED screen boasted a hefty price tag of over $3,299. The laptop's design was revamped again in 2024, introducing a 3K 120Hz OLED panel and reducing its weight to 3.31 pounds. This redesign saw the starting price drop back down to $1,600 for a configuration featuring a Ryzen 9 8945HS processor, 16GB of RAM, and an RTX 4060. In 2025, ASUS launched a new model with an RTX 5070 Ti GPU and twice the usual amount of RAM at 32GB. This top-end configuration retailed for $3,200, while the starting price was listed as $2,499. However, it's worth noting that no configuration priced at $2,199, which was mentioned during CES 2025, went on sale at launch. A cheaper RTX 5060 version was eventually announced in May 2025 for $1,800, bringing the cost of the cheapest G14 model down to a more affordable level. Despite this, the price still lagged behind that of the original model by $750, although it came with an OLED screen and 16GB of RAM. The latest iteration of the G14, launched in 2026, pairs Intel's Core Ultra 9 386H processor with an RTX 5070 Ti GPU. The top-end configuration features 16GB of RAM, a 1TB SSD, and a 2880 x 1800 OLED panel, all for $3,200 directly from ASUS. The price increase of the ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 is largely attributed to the AI-fueled memory crisis. This has led to a significant surge in costs for DRAM and flash memory, which are essential components in gaming laptops like the G14. To mitigate these rising costs, ASUS had informed its partners that it would increase prices on some of its products in January 2025. Unfortunately, this means that even the base model of the G14 is affected by the price hike. The top-end configuration now features a more powerful GPU and higher-end memory, but at a significantly higher cost. In comparison to the original launch price of $1,050 in 2020, the current prices are staggering. When adjusted for inflation, the 2020 price would be equivalent to around $1,370 today. However, no model in the G14 lineup comes close to this price point, making the current prices seem even more excessive. The base model of the G14 with an RTX 5060 GPU and AMD Ryzen AI 9 465 processor is available at Best Buy, but it's still a far cry from the original launch price. For those looking for the cheapest option, this might be the best choice, as prices are unlikely to drop anytime soon. The ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 has become one of the most expensive gaming laptops on the market, with even the base model now priced at an eye-watering level. articles.title: Gucci, Hermès, Estancia Vik, Kendall Jenner, Micato Safaris
articles.summary: International fashion has recently caught up with equestrian enthusiasm, but horses have been at the forefront of luxury brands for decades. Gucci and Hermès built their empires on high-end...
articles.content: International fashion has recently caught up with equestrian enthusiasm, but horses have been at the forefront of luxury brands for decades. Gucci and Hermès built their empires on high-end saddles and tack long before riding boots became a trendy accessory. With the lunar calendar's Year of the Horse underway, it seems every year is indeed a celebration of horse culture. Celebrity Kendall Jenner marked her 31st birthday with an equestrian-themed party, but for those who want to experience the thrill of horseback riding in exotic locations, there are many options available. Some of these adventures take riders on multi-day journeys across vast, unspoiled landscapes, while others offer a chance to immerse oneself in single exceptional properties that provide unique horse experiences. In Uruguay's rolling pampas, Estancia Vik offers horseback riding excursions with an added luxury, a dinner reservation at the property. Riders can explore the countryside under starry skies before returning for a gourmet meal amidst the estancia's rustic charm. This is just one of many extraordinary horseback adventures that allow riders to experience the beauty and majesty of horses in some of the world's most breathtaking locations. Guests embarking on an exclusive equestrian experience in Uruguay are treated to an evening ride under the full moon, accompanied by expert gauchos and majestic Criollo and Quarter horses. The sunset departure from the stables sets the tone for a leisurely journey along the José Ignacio River, culminating in a wine-tasting session and traditional Uruguayan dinner amidst the starry night sky. Meanwhile, in Botswana's vast salt pans of Makgadikgadi, horseback riders can immerse themselves in an unforgettable experience. The seemingly endless expanse provides a unique backdrop for exploring on horseback, with the opportunity to observe local wildlife up close. This enchanting setting is a haven for those seeking a tranquil and awe-inspiring equestrian adventure. In Kenya's expansive plains, experienced riders can participate in Micato Safaris' "Riding the Wild Plains safari, spanning nine nights across Nairobi, Laikipia, and the Maasai Mara. This exclusive excursion allows guests to traverse conservancies alongside iconic species such as giraffes, elephants, and rhinos, accompanied only by the sound of hooves beneath their horses' feet. As travelers venture into Kyrgyzstan's vast expanses, they find that the experience is far from rugged. The country has been a favorite destination of explorer Alexandra Tolstoy for over two decades, and her extensive knowledge of Central Asia makes her an ideal guide. Tolstoy's affinity for Kyrgyzstan stems from her early travels in the 1990s, when she embarked on a remarkable journey by horseback and camel along the Silk Road, covering over 5,000 miles with three friends. This exposure to the region's rich history and culture has instilled in Tolstoy a deep appreciation for the country's unique blend of tradition and natural beauty. Kyrgyzstan's horses play a significant role in its heritage, deeply ingrained in daily life and woven into the fabric of its identity. Horseback riding is an integral part of Kyrgyz culture, with many residents relying on these magnificent animals for transportation and labor. For those who prefer not to commit to a long trip, there are shorter excursions available that still offer a glimpse into this incredible country's natural beauty. The vast expanse of South Africa's Kalahari Desert offers an unparalleled horseback riding experience for seasoned riders at Tswalu Kalahari Reserve, the largest private reserve in the country. Here, riders can traverse miles of grass-covered plains and rolling red dunes, with the added thrill of navigating seasonal riverbeds. This unique landscape is a true testament to nature's majesty. For those who prefer to explore on horseback rather than on foot, Chile presents an attractive option. The continent boasts exceptional hiking trails, but riding allows for more extensive coverage in a single trip. One notable experience is the 10-night Chilean Riding Adventure offered by luxury travel company Red Savannah. This journey begins in the Atacama Desert, where guests ride across the surreal sands of Moon Valley under some of the clearest skies on Earth. The adventure continues as it winds its way through the Lake District and ultimately down to Patagonia, where riders can gallop along remote lagoons beneath the watchful gaze of Andean condors. This is an opportunity to immerse oneself in Chile's breathtaking natural beauty and experience its untamed wilderness from a unique perspective. In Southern France's Camargue region, horses are an integral part of the landscape, blending seamlessly with the salt flats and flamingos that inhabit this wild and picturesque area. Guests at Les Bains Gardiens can experience the thrill of exploring Southern France's Camargue region on horseback through guided two-hour rides. These excursions take riders through the wetlands and out to the beach, offering a unique perspective on this picturesque area. Experienced equestrians can even gallop along the shoreline, while others may prefer to observe the traditional Camargue horses in their natural habitat. The estate often stages jeux gardians," horseback games that showcase the region's rich riding culture and traditions. articles.title: Abelardo de la Espriella's Social Media Campaign Showcases Security Forces' Operations
articles.summary: Colombia's new president Abelardo de la Espriella has been using social media to showcase his security forces' operations against armed groups since taking office in August.
articles.content: Colombia's new president Abelardo de la Espriella has been using social media to showcase his security forces' operations against armed groups since taking office in August. The videos often feature De la Espriella himself speaking directly to the camera, sometimes standing among body bags. One such video was published on September 2 and shows De la Espriella in a room filled with 23 body bags. He is discussing an operation carried out against a dissident faction of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), a former guerrilla group. According to De la Espriella, the operation resulted in the deaths of 23 "terrorists, who he likened to cancer. The video has been viewed nearly half a million times since its posting, and is just one example of De la Espriella's use of social media to promote his security policies. Two days after publishing this first video, De la Espriella shared another similar clip. This second video shows De la Espriella standing in front of four body bags, applauding the death of a leader from the Conquering Self-Defence Forces of the Sierra Nevada (ACSN), a paramilitary group. In the video, he warns that those who refuse to surrender will meet the same fate as the deceased. De la Espriella's message in this video is clear: his government believes that peace can only be achieved through armed force. He has pinned this video on his social media profile, where it has already been viewed two million times. The videos have sparked a growing outcry over De la Espriella's use of repressive policies to promote himself and his security forces. Critics argue that such tactics are counterproductive and will only fuel further violence in the country. The new president's communication strategy has been met with widespread criticism in Colombia, where two videos featuring body bags have sparked outrage. Critics argue that using deceased individuals as a backdrop for presidential declarations is insensitive and perpetuates a culture of violence. One such critic is Iris Marin Ortiz, the People's Defender, who expressed her disapproval on September 6. She noted that the country has been plagued by armed conflicts and organized criminality for decades, but never before had a president boasted about walking amongst the dead. The display of body bags, according to Ortiz, sends a disturbing message: that death is a means to demonstrate authority. This, she emphasized, cannot become the language of the state. NGOs dedicated to human rights have also condemned the videos, arguing that they dehumanize individuals and legitimize violence against them. The Colombian president's unorthodox communication strategy has sparked widespread criticism, with many questioning the ethics of publishing videos that show him walking among body bags. In a move that drew attention to his methods, Parliamentary Deputy Santiago Osorio Marin took the matter to the Bogota tribunal, which ordered the videos to be temporarily removed from the official Instagram account of the Colombian president on September 8. Despite this setback, the president continued to share similar content, including a video published on September 21 after an operation against the paramilitary group ACSN. The images have been widely criticized for their graphic nature and potential impact on public perception. The president has also shared videos showing prisoners with their faces uncovered, wrists and ankles bound, as well as footage of airstrikes from the sky. One such video was published on September 2 after an operation carried out against a dissident faction of former guerrilla group FARC. These tactics have drawn comparisons to those employed by El Salvador's president Nayib Bukele, who has faced criticism for his war on gangs and subsequent sharing of graphic images. The Colombian president's methods have also been likened to the Trump administration's use of aerial strikes in the Caribbean and eastern Pacific, which resulted in over 240 deaths. The videos posted by the Colombian president have sparked concerns about dehumanization and the potential for violence against individuals featured in them. Critics argue that such content can be used to legitimize harm towards those shown. The sharing of these images has also raised questions about the role of social media in presidential communication, with many wondering if this approach is effective or simply attention-seeking. The Colombian president's communication style has been criticized for creating a narrative that portrays him as an effective leader who produces results. De la Espriella often incorporates music from action movies into his videos about law enforcement operations or arrests made. This approach was evident in a video shared on October 2, where he discussed Operation Perla aimed at combating extortion and kidnapping. Critics argue that the president's communication strategy relies heavily on visual aids such as images of body bags, which can be perceived as sensationalistic rather than informative. The use of dramatic music and rhetoric also contributes to this perception. The results of De la Espriella's hardline policies have been met with widespread condemnation from various sectors in Colombian society. The phenomenon known as false positives has resurfaced, where security forces extrajudicially kill civilians who are then presented as guerrillas killed in combat. Between 1990 and 2016, a total of 7,837 false positives were documented by Colombia's Special Jurisdiction for Peace. Most of these incidents occurred during the 2000s when security forces aimed to increase their body count to gain various advantages. The recent death of an eighteen-year-old man named Ricardo Andrés Rodriguez Martinez has drawn parallels with this dark period in Colombian history. He was killed during operations against a paramilitary group, ACSN, which President De la Espriella had praised earlier. His family's claims that the young man was not a guerrilla fighter but rather a day labourer have sparked outrage and calls for truth and justice to be served. The mother of the deceased appeared in a video filmed in front of the Institute of Forensic Medicine in Barranquilla, holding a poster that demanded accountability from the president. The People's Defender has called for a thorough investigation into the circumstances surrounding the death of an 18-year-old man who was found among body bags in a military deployment zone. The official expressed concern that such incidents would not be tolerated and emphasized the need to uncover the facts. In response, the Ministry of Defence stated that it would leave the investigation to the Office of the General Prosecutor and forensic experts. However, this stance has been met with skepticism by critics who argue that a more proactive approach is needed in light of Colombia's history of false positives. One such case involved Luis Carlos Mojica Guzman, who was killed in September, while another recent incident involved Yasmin Rodriguez, who lost her life in October. These cases have reignited concerns about the military's tactics and their impact on local communities. The United Nations has also weighed in on the situation, criticizing De La Espriella's repressive methods and warning that they may not address the root causes of violence in the region. The UN emphasized the need for an institutional response to security issues, including education, health, and respect for human rights. Critics argue that the government's focus on security is at the expense of other important issues, such as rural development, land distribution, and reintegration programs for former combatants. This approach may only treat the symptoms of violence rather than addressing its underlying causes. The UN also highlighted the importance of working with local communities to address their concerns and needs. If not accompanied by an institutional response, military actions may be seen as ineffective and potentially counterproductive in the long run. Armed groups in conflict zones often react to increased military presence by tightening their grip on territory and limiting civilians' access to essential resources. This can lead to further human rights abuses as communities become trapped between warring factions. The president's emphasis on results" seems more like empty rhetoric, disconnected from the actual situation on the ground. The Office of the President declined to comment on these concerns, leaving questions unanswered. articles.title: SpaceX Plans Lunar Economy with AI Satellite Factories
articles.summary: NASA has selected eight companies, including SpaceX and Blue Origin, to compete for contracts worth up to $10 billion to transport equipment and infrastructure to the moon.
articles.content: SpaceX has revealed plans to establish a lunar economy by constructing factories on the moon that would manufacture artificial intelligence (AI) satellites. This ambitious vision hinges on several key technological hurdles being overcome, including transporting equipment and infrastructure to the lunar surface. To achieve this goal, NASA is providing significant financial backing in the form of contracts worth up to $10 billion. The agency has selected eight companies, including SpaceX and Blue Origin, to compete for these lucrative deals. The contracts are designed to facilitate the transportation of equipment and infrastructure to the moon. The selection process marks a major milestone in the development of NASA's lunar base initiative. According to NASA administrator Jared Isaacman, the Moon Base mission will be built incrementally, with each new stage of construction arriving on the lunar surface as astronauts return from Earth. As part of this ambitious endeavor, NASA is seeking solutions for two critical challenges: generating power and maintaining communication links between the moon and Earth. These technical hurdles must be overcome if a permanent human presence on the moon is to become a reality. The intersection of government-funded space programs and private sector initiatives has never been more pronounced than it is today. While NASA's primary objective remains establishing a lunar base capable of supporting long-term human habitation, companies like SpaceX are exploring new revenue streams through lunar-based manufacturing. NASA's ambitious plans for a permanent lunar base are taking shape, with the agency set to send robotic explorers to the moon's south pole in 2029 to identify suitable locations for future infrastructure. The robotic missions will lay the groundwork for subsequent phases of construction, which will focus on building power systems, cargo transportation networks, and communications infrastructure between 2029 and 2032. This setup is intended to support long-term operations on the lunar surface, enabling astronauts to conduct more extensive research and paving the way for deeper space exploration. To overcome the logistical challenges of transporting equipment and supplies to the moon, NASA has enlisted the help of eight private companies selected under its Commercial Lunar Payload Services program. These companies will be eligible to compete for contracts to deliver payloads to the lunar surface over the next decade, using landers to carry scientific instruments, technology, and other infrastructure. In addition to these new partnerships, NASA is also leveraging existing relationships with private companies to advance its lunar ambitions. The agency has awarded a combined $1.3 billion in contracts to Blue Origin, Impulse Space, and Arrow Science and Technology for separate mission tasks, including verifying communications systems between the moon and Earth. These collaborations are crucial to NASA's efforts to establish a sustainable presence on the lunar surface, as the agency seeks to make its outpost livable for astronauts by 2032. NASA is working on several fronts to overcome the challenges of establishing a sustainable presence on the lunar surface. One critical area of focus is reliable communication, which is essential for astronauts and mission controllers to stay connected. To address this issue, NASA has chosen SpaceX to launch satellites aboard its Starship in 2028, with the aim of testing advanced technology that will enable seamless communication. This collaboration is just one aspect of a broader effort by NASA to secure private sector partnerships for its lunar base initiative. The agency has also awarded contracts to several companies, including those owned by Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin, to develop innovative solutions for power generation and wireless power transfer. Specifically, these companies are working on the Mini-Communications and Solar Tower (miniCAST), a planned system that will provide reliable energy and communication capabilities. SpaceX is positioning itself to play a significant role in NASA's lunar base initiative, with ambitious plans to establish space operations beyond mere transportation services. According to its filings, the company intends to build factories on the moon using locally sourced materials to manufacture AI satellites. This would not only reduce costs but also alleviate terrestrial resource constraints. The long-term vision of SpaceX extends far beyond satellite manufacturing. The company envisions exploiting the moon's resources, including rare minerals that could be used in quantum computing systems and nuclear energy production. With an estimated 1 million tons of these valuable materials available on the lunar surface, SpaceX sees a lucrative business opportunity in mining and exporting them to Earth. SpaceX is now eyeing the moon as an ideal location for establishing a constellation of satellites that can perform artificial intelligence computing in space. This ambitious plan would enable the company to expand its computing capacity without relying on traditional data centers on Earth, which are both power-intensive and controversial. The lunar base infrastructure will not only serve as a gateway to Mars and space exploration but also position the moon as a strategic industrial and transportation hub at scale. According to SpaceX's plans, this infrastructure has the potential to establish the moon as a key node in future space-based industries. articles.title: GPU Scam Surge Hits Market Amid High Demand for Graphics Processing Units
articles.summary: A surge in GPU scams has hit the market, taking advantage of the high demand for graphics processing units.
articles.content: A surge in GPU scams has hit the market, taking advantage of the high demand for graphics processing units. The AI industry's insatiable need for GPUs has driven up prices, making affordable options a hot commodity and prime target for scammers. As buyers scramble to find reliable sources, they're often met with fake listings online or in-person. Scammers are selling everything from empty GPU shells to bags of pasta and rice, preying on those desperate to get their hands on a real product. The scam has also affected physical repair shops, which have seen some traded-in GPUs stripped of their memory dies before being resold to unsuspecting consumers. This has led to a significant increase in the number of people falling victim to these scams. With prices for RAM skyrocketing and old GPUs becoming more valuable than ever, it's no wonder scammers are taking advantage of the situation. The key to avoiding these scams lies in being cautious and vigilant when searching for affordable GPUs. When browsing online marketplaces for affordable GPUs, it's essential to maintain a sense of caution and skepticism. This is especially true in 2026, when finding a good deal on a graphics card can be challenging. Any offer that seems too good to be true should raise red flags. Sellers on Facebook Marketplace or eBay may use stock photos to make their products appear more appealing, but this can be a tactic used by scammers. To verify the authenticity of a seller's photo, try searching for it on Google Images. If the image appears in multiple listings or is easily recognizable as a generic stock photo, it could indicate that the seller is using a fake product. Additionally, sellers may attempt to avoid answering questions about their products or rush you into making a purchase. This behavior can be a sign of a scam. Inspecting the GPU for damage after purchase is crucial before putting it to use. To do this, run a stress test using an application like HWiNFO, which allows you to monitor the system's performance in real-time. Opening HWiNFO in full mode and clicking on Sensors gives access to various readings, including peak temperatures and clock speeds. Selecting Stress Test initiates a series of tests that can help identify any potential issues with the GPU. During this test, it is essential to keep an eye on the readings displayed in the window, which provide valuable information about the system's performance. If everything appears normal after around 15 minutes, the GPU should be functioning as expected. However, even if a stress test passes without incident, there are other factors to consider when buying a GPU online. Since it is impossible to physically inspect the product before purchasing, relying on thorough questioning of the seller and reviewing their reputation can help mitigate potential risks. When purchasing a GPU from an online seller, even through a reputable platform like eBay, vigilance is crucial. While buyer protection can offer some assurance, scammers have found ways to exploit these safeguards. They may obtain tracking IDs for your area and provide them to the platform, making it difficult to prove that you didn't receive the product. This tactic allows scammers to shift responsibility from themselves to the courier service or even the buyer, creating a lengthy process to resolve disputes. In some cases, a refund might be possible if proof of a scam is provided to the courier service, but this can still be an arduous and time-consuming process. To avoid these issues altogether, it's essential to remain cautious. Ultimately, exercising caution when buying a GPU from an online seller is crucial, especially in situations where physical inspection is not feasible. By being aware of potential scams and taking necessary precautions, buyers can minimize their risk and ensure a smoother purchasing experience. articles.title: Victims of Nazi war in Poland call on Germany for support
articles.summary: More than 80 years after the end of World War II, Polish victims of the Nazi regime are still waiting for a "humanitarian gesture" from Germany. The 2027 draft budget hasn't left them much hope for possible reparations.

articles.title: German Civil Society Urged to Support Polish Nazi Persecution Survivors
articles.summary: The appeal highlights the plight of around 50,000 survivors living in Poland today who are struggling with illness and rising costs.
articles.content: Polish victims' organizations have issued a urgent appeal to German civil society for support, urging them to provide humanitarian aid to survivors of Nazi persecution living in Poland. The appeal, published on November 5 on the website of the Foundation for Polish–German Reconciliation, highlights the plight of around 50,000 individuals who still live in Poland today. These survivors include former concentration camp inmates, those deported to Germany for forced labor, and people subjected to other forms of Nazi repression. Many of these survivors are over 90 years old, struggling with illness and rising costs, making their daily lives increasingly difficult. The signatories of the appeal warn that any further delay in providing assistance may render help too late, as they face a critical need for support in their remaining days. Germany has acknowledged its moral responsibility towards the surviving victims of Nazi persecution, but a decision on possible reparations by the German federal government is still pending. The legacy of World War II continues to cast a long shadow over German-Polish relations, with one of the most contentious issues being war reparations. In 1989, following Germany's reunification and the transition to democracy in Central and Eastern Europe, the federal government allocated 500 million deutschmarks to support Holocaust victims in Poland. This move aimed to provide some measure of redress for the atrocities committed during the war, but its impact has been widely debated. Poland suffered greatly under Nazi occupation, with an estimated 6 million citizens killed, including approximately 3 million Polish Jews. The German occupation policy was marked by systematic crimes against the Polish population, which has left a deep scar on the country's collective memory. The scale of these atrocities is staggering, with millions displaced, enslaved or murdered as part of the "General Plan East. This plan aimed to uproot and exploit Poland's population, targeting intellectuals, clergy, civil servants and teachers in the Intelligenzaktion from 1939 onwards. Poland has been seeking compensation from Germany for its losses during World War II. The right-wing conservative government that came to power in Poland in 2015 estimated these losses at a staggering 6.2 trillion zloty. As part of this effort, Warsaw officially requested €1.3 trillion from Berlin in October 2022. However, the new center-left government led by Donald Tusk has taken a different approach. Since his election victory in December 2023, Tusk's administration has distanced itself from these demands. Tusk's team is now expecting a more flexible solution from Germany. According to Foreign Minister Radek Sikorski, Poland is looking for a creative arrangement with its German partner. This implies that Warsaw is open to negotiations and alternative forms of compensation. Germany had previously offered €200 million in support, but this was rejected by Tusk as insufficient. The talks between Berlin and Warsaw have been ongoing since then without producing a solution. The Greens party has not abandoned its efforts to secure funding for a humanitarian gesture in support of Polish victims of Nazi war crimes. A request submitted by the parliamentary group to the budget committee was unfortunately rejected, but co-chair Franziska Brantner remains optimistic about the possibility of a change in the coalition's stance. The budget committee is set to hold its final review session this week, which she sees as a last chance for the initiative to move forward. The issue of reparations for Polish families who suffered during World War II continues to be a significant concern in Polish society, with hardly any family left unaffected by the war. According to a recent survey, over half of respondents felt that Germany does not adequately acknowledge the suffering of the Polish people, while only a minority believed that sufficient efforts have been made. The appeal for support from victims' associations may now mobilize civil society in Germany, according to Jakub Deka, chairman of the Foundation for Polish-German Reconciliation. Following an initial appeal in May, hundreds of Germans responded with donations ranging from €50 to several hundred euros. A significant number of respondents in a representative survey believe that Germany has not done enough to acknowledge the suffering of the Polish people during World War II. The ongoing debate highlights the complexities and sensitivities surrounding the issue of reparations for victims of Nazi war crimes in Poland. More than €35,000 has been collected for the foundation supporting victims of Nazi war crimes in Poland, enabling several individuals to receive one-time aid from this fund. The chairman of the foundation references Jerzy Tarasiewicz, a prominent figure who led the victims' association in Gdansk for many years. In an interview with Gazeta Wyborcza, Tarasiewicz had warned that Germany was waiting for the Polish victims to pass away before providing any assistance. Tarasiewicz himself passed away at 84 without seeing this humanitarian gesture" come to fruition, leaving behind a poignant reminder of the need for immediate support. articles.title: Household Responsibilities Alleviated by Hiring House Managers
articles.summary: Kelly Hubbell found relief from household responsibilities by hiring a house manager.
articles.content: Full-time working mom Kelly Hubbell was at her wit's end when she realized just how much time she was devoting to household work - 23 hours a week to be exact. The overwhelming bulk of this time wasn't spent on actual chores, but rather on planning and organization tasks that took up a significant portion of her evenings and weekends. Hubbell recalls thinking it would be wonderful if she could somehow clone herself, freeing up more time for her family and personal life. She began searching for someone to take over these responsibilities, referring to them as a "house manager who could oversee the daily logistics and errands that were weighing her down. After finding a suitable candidate, Hubbell experienced an almost immediate sense of relief, feeling like she could now be fully present with her children and enjoy some much-needed respite from the mental load. The concept of a house manager is slowly gaining traction as a solution to alleviate the burden of household responsibilities on working parents. Online job listings now include house manager" as a sought-after position, and specialized agencies are emerging to connect busy families with qualified professionals. One key distinction between a house manager and a babysitter lies in their level of authority and responsibility. A house manager is empowered to take initiative and make decisions about household matters, such as managing errands or handling finances, whereas a babysitter's role typically involves more hands-on childcare duties. The cost of hiring a house manager can be substantial, with families paying between $25 to $45 an hour for 15 to 20 hours of work per week. This translates to an annual salary range of around $20,000 to $47,000, or even higher for full-time positions that can pay upwards of $50,000 to $120,000 depending on location and scope. The rates charged by companies like Sage Haus are significantly higher than the average hourly rate listed in job postings. According to Indeed, house manager listings typically advertise around $23 an hour, but families willing to invest in a more comprehensive solution may find value in the added support and expertise of a dedicated house manager. For dual-income households struggling to balance work and family responsibilities, the appeal of hiring a house manager lies in its potential to alleviate stress and allow parents to focus on their careers. Research suggests that mothers of young children are disproportionately affected by return-to-office mandates and limited childcare options, with many opting to reduce hours or leave the workforce altogether. Mothers in the US are disproportionately responsible for managing household tasks, with 71% of mental-load duties falling on their shoulders, according to a recent study by researchers from the University of Bath and the University of Melbourne. This significant burden is often invisible, meaning it doesn't receive recognition or compensation, despite being essential to keeping family life running smoothly. In contrast, fathers take on around 45% of these responsibilities, with some tasks overlapping between parents. The stigma surrounding hiring help at home can make people uncomfortable, but Sage Haus aims to normalize this practice by putting a value on the work that has traditionally been left unacknowledged and unpaid. The company's mission is to remove shame and guilt from seeking support for household duties. Sage Haus, which now employs over 60 staff members, offers a range of services, including working with around 100 families each month across the US and Canada. The company also has a network of more than 7,000 house managers who can be hired to assist households, and it sells a certification course for $99 that teaches these individuals how to anticipate needs and provide discreet support. The concept of house management as a career path is gaining traction, with opportunities for advancement to corporate administrative roles and vice versa. Hubbell believes that high executive functioning skills are essential for this type of work, which involves managing complex household needs. According to Oxfam's estimate, the unpaid care work done by women and girls worldwide has a staggering value of at least $10.8 trillion annually. In the US alone, unpaid household labor is valued at up to $6 trillion per year, accounting for about one-fifth of the country's GDP. By paying individuals to manage household tasks, companies like Sage Haus are challenging the notion that such work should be done voluntarily by family members. This shift in perspective may seem indulgent, but it highlights a broader issue: why has unpaid household labor been accepted as a given? articles.summary: The feature allows users to zoom in on their screens at all times by enabling a magnifier shortcut.
articles.content: Frustration is a common experience for many Android users when trying to read small text on their devices. Whether it's news articles, websites, or other content, the inability to zoom in can be infuriating, especially first thing in the morning. This issue has been a persistent problem for me, particularly when using the Google News app. My eyes are not always ready to tackle the day, and tiny text only exacerbates the situation. It's not just limited to reading text either; sometimes images need to be enlarged as well, but pinch-to-zoom doesn't seem to work on certain screens. Fortunately, there is a solution to this problem. An often-overlooked feature in Android devices can be enabled to ensure that users can zoom in on their screens at all times. This feature is called Magnification and can be found within the device's Accessibility settings. The Magnification feature has been available since Android 15, but it was discovered by accident during a routine exploration of the Settings page. Since then, it has become a valuable tool for users who frequently encounter small text or images that require enlargement. Once enabled, the Magnification feature provides a simple shortcut on the screen that can be tapped to instantly enlarge any content. The button can be moved around the display, but it must remain visible as long as the feature is active. As with many features in Android, there are some caveats to consider when using Magnification. One of these is that the magnifier shortcut will remain on the screen as long as the feature is enabled. The Android Magnification feature is designed to be minimally intrusive while still providing assistance for users who struggle with small text. To access this feature, navigate to Settings by sliding down twice from the Notification Shade and tapping the gear icon or searching for "Settings in the App Drawer. The location of this option varies depending on your device's Android version; it can be found under Settings > Accessibility > Magnification on some devices, while others have it listed as Settings > Features > Accessibility. Once you've located the Magnification option, toggle the On/Off slider to enable the feature, and a magnifier button will appear on your screen. This button allows you to instantly enlarge any text or image displayed on your device, making it easier to read without straining your eyes. When using the Magnification feature, you may notice that scrolling is limited to vertical movement only; however, there's a workaround for this limitation. To access more advanced options, tap the gear icon at the bottom right of the display to open the pop-up menu. From here, select the Magnifier size" option located second from the right, which will enable a movable magnification tool that can be placed anywhere on your screen. The movable magnifier allows you to zoom in on specific areas of text or images and adjust its size as needed by tapping one of the available options. You can also customize the magnified text size by dragging the slider at the bottom of the menu, giving you greater control over how much of a text is enlarged. Having access to this hidden tool has greatly reduced my morning struggles with reading news sites on my Android device, even when wearing glasses. The feature allows me to zoom in on text without having to navigate through multiple menus or settings. This functionality has made a significant difference in my daily routine, and I recommend giving it a try to see if it can improve your own Android experience as well. articles.title: White House Staff's Use of Inside Information Investigated by Democratic Senators
articles.summary: Democratic Senators Elizabeth Warren and Jeff Merkley have written to the White House seeking information about staff members using confidential government information for profit.
articles.content: Democratic Senators Launch Investigation into White House Staff's Use of Inside Information for Profit Two prominent Democratic senators have written to the White House, seeking information on whether staff members are using confidential government information to trade on prediction market platforms and profit from their bets. The letter, signed by Sens. Elizabeth Warren (D-MA) and Jeff Merkley (D-OR), was sent to White House counsel Will Scharf on Monday. The senators' inquiry follows a July report that Gabriel Perez, President Trump's teleprompter operator, allegedly made over $100,000 on the prediction market Kalshi by betting on words used in more than a dozen speeches. This revelation has sparked concerns about potential insider trading and misuse of power within the administration. The White House is being asked to disclose what safeguards are in place to prevent staff from using confidential information for personal gain. The senators want to know if any measures have been taken since the incident came to light four months ago, as they seek to understand the extent of the problem and potential solutions. A settlement was reached between Perez and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, requiring him to return his profits, pay a penalty, and agree to a three-year trading ban. The senators' letter expresses their concern that despite this development, no further action has been taken to address the issue. The senators' letter raises further questions about the White House's handling of staff involvement in prediction market betting. Specifically, they want to know whether employees receive training on rules against using nonpublic information for trading or betting purposes. The lawmakers also asked if any officials had contacted regulatory bodies such as the Commodities Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) or the Justice Department about Perez's case. They requested a copy of any memo sent to staff warning them against making bets based on inside knowledge and answers to their questions by November 23. As concerns over insider trading continue to grow, the White House has yet to respond to a request for comment on this matter. The scrutiny is part of a broader trend, with several high-profile cases drawing attention to the use of nonpublic information for financial gain. Several Democrats are calling for stricter regulations on prediction markets, which they argue can be used for insider trading and financial gain. These concerns have been fueled by high-profile cases involving individuals with access to nonpublic information using these platforms. The Trump family's involvement in the industry has raised eyebrows, particularly since Donald Trump Jr. advises two prominent prediction market companies: Kalshi and Polymarket. Furthermore, his venture firm, 1789 Capital, has invested in Polymarket, highlighting the blurred lines between personal interests and professional obligations. As scrutiny of prediction markets continues to intensify, the White House is under pressure to address these concerns and implement stricter regulations to prevent potential abuses by individuals with access to sensitive information. articles.title: Original name for Sesame Street revealed as 123 Avenue B
articles.summary: The original title was one of several options being considered by co-creators Joan Ganz Cooney and Lloyd Morrisett before the program's launch on November 10, 1969.
articles.content: The original name for Sesame Street has been revealed as 123 Avenue B, a title that may not have captured the imagination of audiences worldwide. This was one of several options being considered by co-creators Joan Ganz Cooney and Lloyd Morrisett before the program's launch on November 10, 1969. The creators were working closely with their team to find a suitable name for the show, which aimed to educate young children through entertaining content. The original title 123 Avenue B was meant to connect the series to New York City, drawing inspiration from its diverse population in terms of design, character representation, and understanding of the world. However, this name was ultimately deemed too straightforward because it actually corresponds to an existing street in Alphabet City, located near the East Village in Lower Manhattan. The creators likely wanted a more creative title that would reflect the show's unique identity without being too on-the-nose. Despite its shortcomings, 123 Avenue B does have a certain charm and is fun to say out loud. It is interesting to speculate what could have been if this name had been chosen instead of Sesame Street, which has become an iconic brand around the world. The show's creators ultimately settled on a title that would go on to become synonymous with children's education and entertainment. But it is fascinating to look back at the original options and consider how different the course of history might have been if 123 Avenue B had been chosen as the name for this beloved program. The creators of the iconic children's program had initially considered setting it in Alphabet City, a neighborhood known for its associations with letters and numbers. However, this idea was eventually abandoned in favor of something more distinctive. The name "Sesame Street has its roots in the famous phrase open sesame, which comes from Antoine Galland's translation of Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves. This phrase is a key part of the classic tale from One Thousand and One Nights, where it is used to gain access to a hidden treasure trove. The word sesame was chosen by the creators because they wanted it to evoke a sense of excitement and discovery. According to Sesame Workshop, Sesame Street is meant to be a place where kids can find all sorts of interesting and educational content. In choosing this name, the producers were inspired by the idea that the show would be a treasure trove of learning opportunities for children. The word sesame was seen as a way to convey the sense of wonder and enchantment that they wanted to create on the program. The name has since become synonymous with high-quality educational programming, and it's easy to see why it was chosen in the first place. With its emphasis on learning through play, Sesame Street has captured the imaginations of children around the world. The idea for a television program that could educate children was first explored 60 years ago in 1966 by Joan Cooney, who worked as a documentarian at WNET THIRTEEN, the local PBS station. Cooney's study, The Potential Uses of Television in Preschool Education, was supported by Morrisett, vice president of the Carnegie Corporation of New York. This three-month investigation involved interviewing experts in early learning and children's television producers to answer a crucial question: whether TV could educate young minds. The potential of television as an educational tool became the foundation for Sesame Street and the Children's Television Workshop, now known as the Sesame Workshop. Cooney's research laid the groundwork for a series that would revolutionize children's programming by combining education and entertainment. Sesame Street was pioneering in its approach to preschool education, blending learning with play, imagination, and storytelling. Young viewers developed essential skills through engaging activities like alphabet practice and counting exercises. The show also tackled broader subjects such as health, science, art, music, and dance, providing a comprehensive educational experience for children. By incorporating these various topics, Sesame Street helped parents nurture their child's social skills and emotional intelligence. By combining education with entertainment, Sesame Street provided a unique platform for young learners to expand their knowledge and reasoning abilities while developing essential literacy skills through engaging storytelling and play-based activities. The show's creators wanted to ensure that its content was relevant and engaging for children from diverse backgrounds. As a result, Sesame Street has consistently incorporated multicultural elements into its programming since its debut in 1969. This approach has allowed the show to reach a broad audience worldwide, with over 300 PBS stations carrying it and making it accessible on platforms like Netflix and YouTube. The show's global reach is staggering, with hundreds of millions of children across more than 140 countries tuning in each year. In addition to its widespread popularity, Sesame Street has also expanded its scope through partnerships that produce locally relevant content for specific regions. These co-productions take into account the unique cultural, linguistic, and educational needs of their respective audiences. The iconic address of 123 Sesame Street has been officially bestowed upon the beloved children's television series by New York City's Mayor Bill de Blasio in 2019. This recognition marked a significant milestone in the show's history, celebrating its 50th anniversary. Located on the Upper West Side of Manhattan, the official Sesame Street is situated at the intersection of Central Park West and Broadway, on the block of West 63rd Street. Visitors can take a photo beneath the sign, creating a memorable moment for fans of all ages. The address has become an integral part of Sesame Street's charm, allowing viewers to imagine themselves walking alongside their favorite characters in Alphabet City. Interestingly, while the show itself is filmed at Kaufman Astoria Studios in Queens, this designated address provides a tangible connection to the series' New York roots. Tourists and locals alike can easily access Sesame Street by subway, just as they do in the program. This convenient transportation option allows visitors to immerse themselves in the world of Sesame Street, making it an exciting destination for families and fans. As a result of this official recognition, the designated address has become a popular spot for photo opportunities, allowing fans to capture memories of their visit to 123 Sesame Street. In recognition of its 50th anniversary, Mayor Bill de Blasio officially designated an address on the Lower East Side as 123 Sesame Street" in 2019. This move allowed fans to finally pinpoint the exact location of the iconic street from their favorite children's show. The designation has also made it easier for visitors to find the spot, just like navigating the streets in the program itself. articles.content: Heavyweight legend Stipe Miocic has made a prediction about his former title, which is set to be contested by Ciryl Gane and Josh Hokit in an upcoming bout. The pair will vie for the heavyweight championship that Miocic once held with distinction. Miocic's tenure as champion was marked by three successful title defenses between 2016 and 2018, before he relinquished the belt. However, he regained it in 2019 and went on to defend it until 2021, when he lost to Francis Ngannou. In his final fight, Miocic suffered a TKO loss against Jon Jones in 2024. The heavyweight division has experienced significant turmoil since Miocic's retirement. The champion at the time, Jon Jones, vacated the title after being offered $30 million to face interim champion Tom Aspinall, who was subsequently elevated to undisputed champion. However, Aspinall's reign was short-lived, as his first defense ended in a no-contest against Ciryl Gane due to repeated eye pokes. Gane's victory over Aspinall led to the British fighter vacating the title this September, 11 months after their initial encounter. Aspinall had been dealing with ongoing complications from the eye injury he sustained during the fight. The upcoming UFC 334 event has generated significant interest among fans, with the main attraction being Ciryl Gane's first defense of his undisputed heavyweight title against Tai Tuivasa's opponent, Francis Ngannou's replacement, Tai Tuivasa's original opponent was supposed to be but is now replaced by Tai Tuivasa's new opponent. The fight will take place on November 14th at Madison Square Garden, a venue where Stipe Miocic had previously retired. In an interview with the media, Miocic shared his thoughts on the upcoming bout, stating that he believes Gane has the edge over Hokit due to his extensive experience and skills. Miocic pointed out that while Hokit is a skilled wrestler and possesses significant punching power, Gane's ability to maintain distance and minimize mistakes will give him an advantage in the fight. He also acknowledged Hokit's potential danger when taken down, but emphasized Gane's strong defensive wrestling skills as a major factor in his favor. Miocic's prediction that Gane will emerge victorious is based on his assessment of their respective skill sets and experience levels. With Gane being more seasoned and having fought tougher opponents in the past, Miocic believes he has the upper hand in this matchup. Miocic believes that Hokit's inexperience in the UFC could be an advantage for Gane, who has faced tougher opponents in the past and is more seasoned. Gane's wrestling background gives him a unique edge in the heavyweight division, allowing him to adapt quickly if needed. However, Miocic notes that Hokit hits hard and comes forward aggressively, which could pose a challenge for Gane if he allows himself to get caught with a clean shot. Miocic also comments on Hokit's tendency to drop his hands, leaving him vulnerable to counterattacks, but praises the fighter's overall development. Miocic sees potential in a future rematch between Tom Aspinall and Ciryl Gane, suggesting that the next fight could be very different from their previous encounter. He believes that Aspinall, known for his gameplans, will likely adjust his strategy if he faces Gane again, making it difficult to predict the outcome of such a matchup. Miocic notes that in their last fight, Gane seemed to tailor his approach to suit Aspinall's style, but this time around, Aspinall may have a new plan in store for him. Miocic acknowledges that fighters often struggle to stick to their original strategy when faced with adversity in the octagon. When a fighter gets caught up in the heat of battle and starts taking risks, they may abandon their initial plan. This can be seen as a potential advantage for Gane if he manages to stay focused on his game plan, choosing his shots carefully and avoiding unnecessary risks. Miocic believes Hokit is a formidable opponent but doesn't think he's quite ready to take down Aspinall yet.
